notes.title: BPM Bitcrushed Announced!
notes.notes:
[h1]BPM Bitcrushed Announced![/h1][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to reveal [b]BPM Bitcrushed[/b] — the newest entry in the BPM universe![/p][p]It carries forward the same pulse-pounding rhythm-shooting combat you loved in BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE, reimagined as a top-down, retro-inspired roguelite. It’s a bold new expression of BPM’s world — a passion project created by the original team.[/p][p]And if you’re an FPS fan, don’t be worried, we’re not finished with BPM.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="JkDRmvK3QlA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]What is BPM Bitcrushed?[/b][/h2][p][b]BPM Bitcrushed[/b] is a [b]top-down,[/b] [b]roguelite dungeon crawler rhythm game[/b] that fuses the action of [i]BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE[/i] with retro-inspired pixel art. Every shot, dodge, and jump is tied to the beat — making rhythm as vital as reflex.[/p][list][*][p]Explore [b]procedurally generated dungeons[/b] packed with enemies, weapons, and items. [/p][/*][*][p]Fight foes who attack in sync with the music — every battle is a deadly dance. [/p][/*][*][p]Add your own tracks with [b]custom music support[/b] to experience new rhythm-driven chaos.  [/p][/*][*][p]Compete in [b]Daily Runs[/b] and leaderboards, or replay exact dungeon layouts using unique [b]seeds[/b] for competitive or speedrun challenges. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3448070"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37636403/15b4551a2661e4a40d9c03f750dac7dc9734355e.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]Story: The Final Beat[/b][/h2][p]Ragnarok looms — the end of the world. The universe’s heartbeat, the [b]Azure Ember[/b], is fading, and only you can restore its rhythm. Collect [b]Melody Fragments[/b] to push back the darkness while [b]Hel, Queen of Helheim[/b], works to hasten Ragnarok by draining its pulse.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Rhythm Combat[/b][/h2][p]Combat is a [b]dance of destruction[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Enemies swarm and strike in perfect time with the music. [/p][/*][*][p]Their most dangerous attacks are telegraphed beats ahead — giving you a chance to dodge or counter. [/p][/*][*][p]Your victory depends not just on accuracy, but on keeping in perfect rhythm. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Death is Not the End[/b][/h2][p]Every run makes you stronger.[/p][list][*][p]When you fall, you return to [b]The Sanctum[/b], your hub of progression. [/p][/*][*][p]Permanent unlocks — new characters, weapons, enemies, and more — persist between runs. [/p][/*][*][p]Master the rhythm, upgrade your arsenal, and push further each attempt. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Features at a Glance[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Rhythm-based top-down roguelite combat. [/p][/*][*][p]Procedural dungeons for infinite replayability. [/p][/*][*][p]Custom music support for your own soundtrack. [/p][/*][*][p]Daily Runs with online leaderboards. [/p][/*][*][p]Setlists & Songpacks to assign music per dungeon. [/p][/*][*][p]Progression system with unlockable characters, weapons, and items. [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]BPM Bitcrushed is not a sequel — it’s a love letter to the BPM universe in a brand new form.[/b] If you loved BPM: BULLETS PER MINUTE, you’ll feel right at home here… just from a new perspective.[/p][p]Stay tuned — we can’t wait to share more. [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: BPM x Robobeat Collab Announcement
notes.notes:
Are you looking for a real challenge?

Shooting is easy. Shooting in sync to a rock opera epic or an EDM anthem requires real skill.
That’s why we’re preparing the ultimate rhythm shooter game bundle just for you.

[previewyoutube=ofwafC4NfCE;full][/previewyoutube]

We’ll be offering the perfect bundle for rhythm shooter fans when Robobeat launches on May 14th.
The upcoming bundle will include:

BPM: Bullets Per Minute, and Robobeat, a roguelite rhythm shooter where you take on the role of robo-gunslinger Ace as he hunts down the chaotic showman Frazzer. Wall run, slide, and bunny hop your way through Frazzer’s ever-shifting lair, and shoot in sync to the music to maximize your damage. Uncover new cassettes to use as you play, or march to the beat of your own drum by uploading your tracks using the custom music feature and playing with the songs you love.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37636403/8653aca78435c6d017772f78241b7e4cbf581423.png[/img]

If you already own BPM: Bullets Per Minute, you’ll still be able to take advantage of the bundle. Instead of buying the full bundle, however, you’ll be given the option to complete the set and receive a 10% discount on Robobeat, which will stack with any other discounts that are available on Robobeat at the time!

Robobeat will be releasing on May 14th, but they currently have a demo available on their store page for you to try out.

Alongside the bundle, Robobeat will also be including a BPM-style room and two tracks from the BPM: Bullets Per Minute soundtrack in the game, so keep an eye out for those when the game releases on May 14th.

When we originally released BPM: Bullets Per Minute, we had no idea that it would become so popular and we are still incredibly grateful to our fans for making this possible. With this bundle, we’re hoping to bring more recognition to the rhythm shooter genre and make sure you get more of the fast, frenetic, and rhythmical action that started with BPM: Bullets Per Minute.

notes.title: BPM: Custom Music Update
notes.notes:
BPM's most requested feature is finally here: Custom Music.

We've been very busy working on the Nintendo Switch port of BPM, but now that's done we are finally able to bring this feature to BPM on PC.

You are now able to add music that you have created into BPM, and will be able to shoot, dodge and dash to the beat of your own soundtrack.

Here is a tutorial video that will show you how to get your music set up to work in BPM:
https://youtu.be/iRj82LgFN7o

Notes & Known Issues:

[list]
[*].MP3 files may cause syncing issues which could result in the music going out of time with the beat. Use .WAV to be safe.
[*]BPM will likely stutter (temporarily) a number of times throughout gameplay due to this update. This is completely temporary and because your GPU needs to recache shaders.
[*]Custom music can only be toggled on or off from the main menu.
[*]In Custom Music mode, pausing and unpausing the game will cause the music to restart.
[*]In Custom Music mode, your track's name and bpm will be displayed on the in-game TAB menu
[*]The game will recalibrate your BPM to be between 60 and 120 BPM. In our testing we think the game plays best with songs that are 70-90BPM.
[/list]

notes.title: Rhythm-based shooter BPM: Bullets Per Minute heads to consoles in October
notes.notes:
Playtonic Friends has announced that BPM: Bullets Per Minute, the first title from its new publishing label, is coming to PS4 and Xbox One.

Developed by Awe Interactive and originally released last September on PC, the game is described as a fast and frenetic rhythm-based shooter with dungeon-based action. In the game, a single move, shot, jump, and dodge will be pulled off to the beat of a rock soundtrack.

With the game, console players will be able to play additional content that was rolled out for the PC version including five brand new characters, three new weapons, a brand new chapter with its own unique enemies, two new difficulties, and a mixture new items, achievements, and assorted tweaks.

Read more

notes.title: BPM: Localisation & Performance Upgrade
notes.notes:
We're bringing BPM to the world!

[list]
[*] Localisation added for German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese - Simplified
[*] “The Crypt” track added to the Steam OST
[*] “Reload by Firing” Setting
When turned on, the firing your weapon button also acts as the reload button
[*] Photosensitivity Warning
[*] Performance Optimisations
[*] Memory Optimisations ( the game uses 40% of the RAM it used to! )
[*] Lighting and graphics have been optimised to improve performance on low-end PCs
[*] Improvements to stutters (some do remain)
[*] Improvements to autoaim on gamepad
[*] Improvements to loading times
[*] Latency Test added
This does NOT fix or calibrate any latency issues, but will reveal them if present. Extreme latency will make BPM unplayable in it’s intended way of playing. If detected, the game will turn on Assisted-Rhythm mode. (99% of PC players will not have any issue with latency. The majority of latency issues will come from BPM being played on TVs with poor latency, and bluetooth headphones/speakers)
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug in Vanaheim where enemy spawns directly in front of you
[*] Fixed double weapon glitch (Mengiyord)
[*] Fixed revolver pickup sound playing during loading screens
[*] Fixed Multiplier UI glitch
[*] Fixed glitch in Svartalfheim where an enemy can teleport behind the wall
[*] Removed Herobrine
[*] + many more
[/list]

This update has put us in a good place with lots of optimisations for consoles that we can build on in our future games. We aren't done with the BPM franchise folks!

notes.title: 90 ударов в минуту: Обзор BPM: Bullets Per Minute
notes.notes: В апреле 2020 года инди-разработчик Дэн Да Роча выложил в социальной сети Twitter небольшой ролик с интересным концептом шутера, в котором нужно стрелять в определенном ритме под музыку. Видео оказалось весьма популярным, его даже заметил сам Клифф Блезински, отец серий Unreal и Gears, назвавший идею энтузиаста самой инновационной в жанре FPS со времен SUPERHOT. Дэн решил воплотить свою задумку в жизнь и начал разрабатывать проект Gun Jam, но каково было его удивление, когда буквально через месяц состоялся анонс другой игры в таком же стиле - BPM: Bullets Per Minute, а чуть позже и еще одной - Metal: Hellsinger. Несмотря на то, что Gun Jam анонсировали раньше, именно BPM успела сорвать куш и выстрелить самой первой.

notes.title: Patch #1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for a great launch! We’re so happy to see people enjoying the unique experience that BPM offers. We’ve been working on a patch last week to fix some issues. This is not the end of our support for BPM but the beginning. 

[list]
[*] Feature – Added a 3rd wave challenge chest that holds the some of the best items in the game. 
[*] Feature – Added new weapon.
[*] Feature – Map goes to the middle of the screen when you press tab.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed – If you fall off a platform you can’t double jump. (ODR run killer)
[*] Fixed – Game restoring the player to bad locations after falling into pits.
[*] Fixed – A few unoptimised textures. (Minor improvement)
[*] Fixed – Duplicate skeleton keys and duplicate lucky dice appearing.
[*] Fixed – Mage enemy getting stuck in walls. 
[*] Fixed – Audio settings not loading on launch.
[*] Fixed – Toned down some screen flashes. More to be done here. 
[*] Fixed – Dragon’s Heart has been renamed “Dragon’s Skin” and the description modified to be less confusing.
[*] Fixed – “Asp's Whisper” combined with certain weapons completely stopping bosses moving.
[*] Fixed – Upped max FOV to 145 for ultrawidescreen users.
[*] Fixed – Raygun impact effect is off time. (Removed impact for raygun)
[/list]
[list]
[*] Tentatively Fixed – Music changing volume as you move.
[*] Tentatively Fixed – Stuck in room with closed doors.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Balance – On easy baby bats have a range limitation. 
[*] Balance – On easy baby bats have fire slower projectiles. 
[*] Balance – Default pistol range slightly buffed by 1.5m.
[*] Balance – Raygun is more rare.
[*] Balance – Cooldown reduction appears less. Appears in challenge chests. 
[*] Balance – Drop rates for items have been changed. 
[*] Balance – Less coins drop in later chapters. There was an over abundance of coins in later chapters.
[*] Balance – Some weighting towards filling all stat statues. 
[*] Balance – Nidhogg health quadrupled.
[*] Balance – Vanaheim onwards boss health increased.
[*] Balance – Dragon’s Skin has been made more rare and moved into the ‘Valkyrie’ pool.
[*] Balance – Dragon’s Skin has been nerfed to build shield at 50% of the previous rate. 
[*] Balance – Demon pools have been modified to favour good stuff. 
[*] Balance – Mechanised Monster does a similar effect to the shield enemies to better communicate that they can’t be damaged when locked down.
[*] Balance – Gauss cannon has been slightly nerfed, but it’s still heart-rendingly OP. 
[*] Balance – Gauss cannon is more often on the ‘expensive’ pedestal in the armoury.
[*] Balance – Heal ultimate is less powerful. 
[*] Balance – Other small fixes.
[/list]

You’ll have to start a new run to get some of these changes. 

We’ve been reading your comments. We’ll be focusing on doing the things that improve the game for everyone over the coming months. Going forwards we want to add more: difficulties, challenges, characters, items, modes and weapons.

notes.title: Eleven great PC games not to miss in September
notes.notes:
Centuries from now, physicists puzzling over the practical realities of time travel will look back on spring and summer 2020 with a mix of wonder and horror at how we've managed to make them disappear.

It's extraordinary to think that we're almost six months on from the date that lockdown was imposed here in the UK, and yet the calendar doesn't lie. Many of the biggest releases of the year have of course been pushed back by Covid-19 and its ripples across the industry, but that doesn't mean there's nothing going on in September - far from it. And as our list of games not to miss in August so ably proved with its prediction that Fall Guys would become a hit, some of the very best games can come out of the indie and mid-tier side of the business.

This month, we put the spotlight on upcoming games from a wide range of genres - sometimes within the same game. Highlights include a retro sci-fi Soulslike in which your decisions have narrative and gameplay consequences, an experimental lo-fi creative game that allows you to paint overgrown post-apocalyptic scenes, and a rhythm-FPS that finally cements Doom's flirtation with metal at a gameplay level.

notes.title: BPM: Bullets Per Minute is a beat-based FPS that looks oh so satisfying to play
notes.notes:
Plenty of FPS games will time their trailers so that all the shooting and kabooming happens on the beat (lookin’ at you, Borderlands 3), but in BPM: Bullets Per Minute that’s actually how it plays. I need you to do me a favor and stroll on in here to watch this rockn’ trailer that does it more justice than I can with my meager words. In brief though, you’re a valkyrie shooting and blasting hell creatures to the beat of some excellent rock opera tunes. It’s planned for an August 2020 release.

(more…)
